name: kbd
behavior: None — presentational. Renders the native <kbd> element so assistive tech announces the content as keyboard input; never focusable, never interactive, and pointer-inert so it cannot swallow clicks on the surface hosting it.

parts.note: one key cap; sized from the control ramp so it aligns with adjacent text and controls
a chord or sequence (Ctrl+K); the separator between caps is caller-supplied text, not a part

anatomyNotes: Salt Kbd's variant primary|secondary|tertiary selects a container background tier and adds a bottom-edge shadow to suggest a physical key; shadcn paints a flat surface-sunken chip. Both are RECIPE differences on root — the same single part — so no axis is declared: a three-tier container ramp is a theme concern, not a component contract. Salt's capitalize + code family is likewise recipe, expressed here through type-code.
